case.final_message:
Thanks for flagging this. On your February 2026 invoice INV-2026-0142 we can see two successful card payments of 49.00 yuan each (PAY-88212 and PAY-88213), taken 41 seconds apart on 2 February 2026. Your other invoices each show a single 49.00 yuan payment.

That second February payment looks like the extra charge. A refund of 49.00 yuan needs approval from an operator before it is issued, and no arrival date is promised. No refund has been issued yet.
